title: Near
description: Teleports you near your death point (not on it) a smarter "/back" alternative with dimension support, temporary tools, and protection effects.
body:
## 🧭 Near A Smarter /back Alternative
Tired of dying and respawning right on top of your **~~killer~~?** Near teleports you near your death point not on it  giving you a fighting chance to recover your items.

 
### ✨ Features

🎯 **Smart Teleportation** Spawns you 100–250 blocks away from your death point in a random direction. Safe landing guaranteed no suffocating underground, no spawning mid-air, no landing in lava.

🌍 **Full Dimension Support** Died in the Nether? The End? No problem. Near teleports you within the same dimension your death occurred overworld, nether, and end all supported. (some mods may be not compatible)

🛡️ **3-Minute Protection** After teleporting you receive:

- Resistance II
- Fire Resistance
- Water Breathing
  
🪓 **Temporary Tool Kit** Receive a temporary iron pickaxe and axe (10% durability) to help you dig back to your loot. Both are automatically deleted after 3 minutes wherever they are.

⏱️ **5-Minute Cooldown** Prevents abuse. Remaining cooldown is shown in seconds.

📜 **Previous Death** Used 
```
/trigger near
```
 already? 
```
/trigger nearprev
```
 sends you near your previous death location.
 

🌐 **Multi-Language** Includes a **[resource pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/5uDS0Pae/versions/msAfefd7/NearTranslations.zip?mr_download_reason=standalone)** with translations for: 🇬🇧 English · 🇹🇷 Turkish · 🇪🇸 Spanish · 🇫🇷 French · 🇧🇷 Portuguese · 🇨🇳 Chinese

 

 
### 📦 Installation
1. Download NearDatapack.zip and place it in 
   ```
   saves/<WorldName>/datapacks/
   ``` 
2. Download **[NearTranslations.zip](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/5uDS0Pae/versions/msAfefd7/NearTranslations.zip?mr_download_reason=standalone)** and place it in 
   ```
   resourcepacks/
   ```
   then enable it in-game
3. Run 
   ```
   /reload
   ```
   in-game
 
4. Done, look for the confirmation message.
 

 
### 🎮 Commands


```
Command	Description
 /trigger near	 Teleport near your last death (no op required)
 /trigger nearprev	 Teleport near your previous death
```

 

 
### 📋 Requirements

Minecraft Java Edition **1.20 - 26.1.2**
No mods required datapack / resourcepack only

**[NearTranslations.zip](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/5uDS0Pae/versions/msAfefd7/NearTranslations.zip?mr_download_reason=standalone)**
